description: This file defines a singleton object `VoiceWakeCommandExtractor` with a function `extractCommand` that processes a text to extract a wake command based on trigger words, using regex matching and string manipulation. It also includes an extension function to determine if a character is punctuation.

classes.name: VoiceWakeCommandExtractor
classes.description: Singleton object providing a method to extract wake commands from input text based on trigger words.

methods.name: extractCommand
methods.description: Extracts a command following trigger words from input text, returning null when no valid command is found.
